mentions.name: Fit Shapes
mentions.description: A macro tracking app focused on removing taps, built for daily use because existing macro trackers tend to be ugly, tedious, or expensive. A launch video combining AI-generated app screens, animated stills, and AI-created music is on the homepage.
mentions.problem: Most existing macro trackers are some combination of ugly, tedious, and expensive.
mentions.source_excerpt: I know there are a thousand of macro trackers out there, but most of them are some combination of ugly, tedious, expensive. Since it's an app I use every day I tried to make my own with a focus on removing taps.
mentions.author: samsolomon
